name: Stinger
code:
sheet({title:'Stinger', units:'in'})

// Robots must fit inside the 18 x 18 x 18 box during initialization
box(-9,-9,0, 18,18,18, {fill:C.white, alpha:0.15, limit:true})

// Variables
const W=16.12, L=17          // frame outside width (x) and length (y)
const T=2.76, H=3.72, Z0=1   // side pod width, pod height, bottom of the frame above the tiles
const CT=1.89, CH=0.47, CZ=1.81   // cross member: depth (y), height, bottom above the tiles
const XI=W/2-T               // x of the pods' inside faces (±XI)
const WR=1.89, WW=1.5, WY=6.5   // wheel radius, width, axle y (front at -WY, rear at +WY)
const G=0.15                    // clearance around a wheel


// side pods: outer faces at ±W/2
box(-W/2, -L/2, Z0,  T, L, H, {fill:C.alu})   // left
box( XI,  -L/2, Z0,  T, L, H, {fill:C.alu})   // right (starts at W/2-T so it ENDS at W/2)

// cross members: span the gap between the pods
box(-XI,  L/2-CT-1.1, CZ,  2*XI, CT, CH, {fill:C.alu})   // rear, same place as yours (y 6 → 7.89)
box(-XI, -CT/2, CZ,  2*XI, CT, CH, {fill:C.alu})   // centre cross member


// pods and wheels, both sides
const ZT=2*WR+G                               // slab bottom clears the wheel tops
for (const s of [-1, 1]) {                    // -1 = left, +1 = right
  const x0 = s<0 ? -W/2 : XI                  // where this pod starts in x
  box(x0, -L/2, ZT,  T, L, Z0+H-ZT, {fill:C.alu})                       // top slab
  box(x0, -L/2, Z0,  T, L/2-WY-WR-G, ZT-Z0, {fill:C.alu})                // front block
  box(x0, -WY+WR+G, Z0,  T, 2*(WY-WR-G), ZT-Z0, {fill:C.alu})            // middle block
  box(x0,  WY+WR+G, Z0,  T, L/2-WY-WR-G, ZT-Z0, {fill:C.alu})            // rear block
  const wx = x0+(T-WW)/2                                                 // wheel centred in the pod
  cyl(wx, -WY, WR,  WR, WW, {axis:'x', fill:C.dark})                     // front wheel
  cyl(wx,  WY, WR,  WR, WW, {axis:'x', fill:C.dark})                     // rear wheel
}




// dimensions:
dim([-W/2,-L/2,Z0+H], [-W/2, L/2,Z0+H], {off:40})         // pod length (prints L)
dim([-W/2,-L/2,Z0+H], [-XI, -L/2,Z0+H], {off:40})         // pod width (prints T)
dim([-W/2,-L/2,Z0],   [-W/2,-L/2,Z0+H], {off:-40})        // pod height (prints H)
dim([-W/2,-L/2,Z0],   [ W/2,-L/2,Z0],   {off:80})         // overall width (prints W)
leader([-W/2, 0, Z0+H], 'side pod, 2×', -60, -40)
leader([0, L/2-CT-1.1, CZ+CH], 'cross member, 2×', 60, -50)
